_about: Generated by tools/protocol-re/pdb.py layouts2016 from the 2016 server PDBs in Files/Server/NA2016 (work item S01; same builds as Files/Server/2016). Evidence level pdb2016 (counts as read in the 2016 code). Merged from Zone, WorldManager, Login, Account, AccountLog: per opcode the first PDB (in that order) whose own PROTO struct exists; a struct only reached through the CLIENT_/ZONE_ name alias is used only when no PDB has the exact struct. "pdbs" = the PDBs whose opcode enums carry the value; "disagreements" = exact structs that differ between PDBs. Offsets are PROTO struct offsets. Server-internal packets about a player carry a 6-byte ref (NETPACKETZONEHEADER clienthandle, charregistnumber; docs/knowledge/Z01.md): about 215 structs declare it as their first member (header.clienthandle, ...), the others do not include it. Field types follow annotations.json; a dimension that is a field name means "count taken from that field" (guessed by name). Empty structs are size 0. "alts": alias names sharing the value; decoders pick the one whose size fits the payload.
